title: Croppies lie down.
html_source:
This is a traditional Protestant loyalist song. Croppies is a general term for Irish rebels which comes from the close-cropped hairstyles the rebels wore during the Wexford Rebellion.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=orLeh3GsY6s

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Used by Stephen to silently resist his oppressor.

anchor.prefix: mmortal memory. The lodge of Diamond in Armagh the splendid behung with corpses of papishes. Hoarse, masked and armed, the planters' covenant. The black north and true blue bible.
